findings.problem: Subject line is 63 characters — exceeds the 50-character limit.
findings.fix: Shorten to 50 chars or fewer, e.g. "Introducing MezbanPOS — now live"

findings.problem: Subject uses banned words: "revolutionise" and "AI-powered" (as a standalone selling point).
findings.fix: Remove both. Lead with a concrete benefit instead, e.g. "Run your front-of-house with less effort"

findings.problem: Preview uses three banned phrases: "Transform", "cutting-edge", and "next-generation".
findings.fix: Replace with plain language, e.g. "See how MezbanPOS helps you manage orders, tables, and staff in one place"

findings.problem: Greeting is "Hi there," — missing the required {{first_name}} merge tag.
Uses two banned words: "leverage" and "state-of-the-art", plus passive voice ("exciting opportunity to leverage").
findings.fix: Rewrite plainly, e.g. "We wanted to tell you about MezbanPOS — a POS built specifically for restaurants."

findings.problem: "Our AI-powered solution will transform your business" is an explicitly forbidden claim. "unlock unprecedented revenue" uses a banned word. "guaranteed 40% revenue increases" promises a specific guaranteed outcome — also forbidden.
findings.fix: Remove all three claims. If you have real customer results, cite them honestly without guarantees. Remove any mention of AI as the selling point.

findings.problem: NEW: "This is your last chance to sign up before prices go up forever." uses false scarcity and dishonest urgency, contradicting the brand's core "Honest" voice principle.
findings.fix: Remove or replace with an honest value statement, e.g. "We'd love to have you on board — here's how to get started."

findings.problem: A second link `[See results](https://mezbanpos.com/case-studies/)` appears after the main CTA. The rule requires exactly one link pointing to https://mezbanpos.com/. This line breaks both constraints.
"Best regards" is a formal closing explicitly listed as forbidden.
findings.fix: Replace with a warm, direct sign-off from the guide, e.g. "Talk soon," or "Happy to dig into this with you."
